description: A food–drug interaction described by the Food Interactions with Drugs Evidence Ontology (FIDEO), directed from the drug Compound to the Food. Each Compound–Food pair has one relationship. Individual interactions carry a FIDEO identifier but no evidence annotations, confidence scores or mechanism types.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the interaction; FIDEO is represented by the value "FIDEO".

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Timestamp of creation or a change to the interaction identifier.

common_properties.name: interaction_id
common_properties.description: FIDEO ontology class identifier for the food–drug interaction, as a CURIE such as FIDEO:000001500.

source_contributions.scope: Interactions whose drug and food are represented by existing Compound and Food nodes. Food coverage is limited to FOODON-identified entities; DRON-identified herbal or botanical food entities and FIDEO-native food entities are excluded.
source_contributions.description: FIDEO describes interactions between foods and drugs. Drug coverage includes ChEBI-identified drugs and DRON-identified drugs with corresponding DrugBank identifiers. The ATC classification hierarchy, DrugBank entries and FDI mechanism ontology are outside this contribution.
